Technical Specification for 3KVA Online UPS A. Section Includes The work specified in this Section includes, but shall not be limited to, a continuous duty. single-phase, solid state, static UPS. The UPS and associated equipment shall operate in conjunction with a primary power supply (utility and/or on-site generation) and an output to provide quality uninterrupted power for mission critical electronic equ ipment load. The system shall consist of a solid state IGBT rectifier and inverter, power factor corrected re ctifier, a 100 percent rated, continuous-duty graphical status display, and synchronizing circuitry as descri bed herein. The UPS control logic shall incorporate state of the art digital signal processing. The inverters s hall utilize high speed pulse width modulation. The UPS shall require rear or side access for maintenance o r repair. Cooling shall require air intake from the front and side and air exhaust from the rear of the UPS. T he UPS shall be capable to be synchronized with mains supply. The UPS shall support frequency conversio n. Conformal Coating for PCB. The UPS must include an inbuilt isolation transformer (UPS OEM make). Exter nal or outsourced transformers will not be accepted. B. Certification 1. 2. 3. Note: The branches currently have one UPS ins talled with a single input supply connection. The proposed procurement is for implementation of a dual UP S system. Therefore, the UPS should have an automatic Switching technique. If one UPS gone down (or its backup is exhausted), the system should automatically switch to other UPS to ensure continuous power su pply. This functionality should be provided to bank without any cost. Kindly consider the pricing accordingl y during the bidding process. 1.
